jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: The "Manager" title and £52,088 Project/Regional Leads/Managers pay band place this well above entry-level, and a strategic litigation lead role would require senior legal and management experience the candidate lacks. Reprieve's human-rights and justice mission is a perfect interest match, but the level is a hard mismatch.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employer pension contribution

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is a genuine entry-level (Coordinator band) role at a core-mission human-rights organisation, so it is eligible and winnable, but it is a fundraising function that draws on marketing/donor-development skills the candidate does not have and away from research and analysis. The Reprieve context is compelling, but the fundraising specialism sits outside the candidate's strengths and interests, holding the priority down.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% employer pension contribution

jobs.title: Script Editor (EastEnders)
jobs.reason: The role's essential criteria require proven prior experience as a TV drama Script Editor and in-depth knowledge of EastEnders — professional media-production experience the candidate does not have. It is also based in Borehamwood, outside London with no London-office or fully-remote-UK option, failing the London-only filter. The subject is wholly outside the candidate's research, policy and intelligence interest zones.

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a Director role with ultimate executive responsibility, leading a senior team of three Deputy Directors — far beyond entry-level and requiring extensive senior leadership experience the candidate does not have. The £80k–£95k salary and executive scope confirm the seniority mismatch, so it is ineligible despite the relevant subject area.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role — it seeks established practitioners/activists and reads as a voluntary advisory appointment rather than a salaried vacancy the candidate could take. The human-rights and securitisation subject is on-mission, but the level and nature of the post are a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellowship x2 (SARChI Chair) (AC.09.4)
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD in public health, health economics, or biostatistics (obtained within the past five years), which the candidate does not hold — a hard disqualifier for a postdoctoral role. The health-workforce / public-health focus is also well outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Senior Auditor - Food
jobs.reason: Ineligible on multiple hard grounds: a "Senior" title requiring a minimum of 5 years' food-industry experience, plus essential food-technology qualifications and 3rd-party auditing certifications (FSSC 22000, BRCGS, HACCP) the candidate does not hold. The role is entirely outside the candidate's field and skill set.

jobs.title: International Member Youth Representative (4254)
jobs.reason: This is an unpaid volunteer governance role, which is excluded by policy regardless of fit. It also requires being 22 or younger and having been an active international member for over a year — criteria the candidate does not meet. Despite the human-rights context, it is not a genuine paid role for the candidate.
jobs.location: Not specified (remote / global; not IS office-based)
jobs.salary: Not specified (unpaid volunteer role; travel expenses covered)

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, Nature Reviews Computing
jobs.reason: The role names a PhD in a topic relevant to the journal as the ideal-candidate requirement, and the field is computer science / AI / theoretical computing — an already-completed doctorate in a technical field the candidate does not hold, which is a hard disqualifier. It is also far outside the candidate's international-law and policy background.

jobs.title: International Member Representative (4253)
jobs.reason: This is an explicitly volunteer role ("BÉNÉVOLE – Représentant·e"), unpaid apart from travel expenses, which is a hard disqualifier regardless of merit. Additionally, it requires being an active international member for over a year and is only open to members in countries without an official Amnesty section, which the candidate is not. The human-rights subject is a strong interest match, but neither the paid nor eligibility conditions are met.
jobs.location: Not specified (remote, for international members outside official Amnesty sections)
jobs.salary: Not specified (unpaid volunteer role; travel expenses covered)

jobs.title: Social Impact Reporting and Operations Analyst
jobs.reason: The posting says "lead and manage" DEI/CSR reporting and repeatedly asks for proven, hands-on experience across HRIS platforms, ESG/impact reporting frameworks (GRI, SROI, logic models) and BI tools like Qlik/Power BI — this is a mid-level specialist ownership role, not entry-level, and it requires substantive domain experience the candidate lacks. It also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones (HR/CSR analytics rather than international law, geopolitical risk or OSINT/tech policy).

jobs.title: Process Improvement Programme Manager
jobs.reason: A "Programme Manager" role requiring substantial process-improvement / transformation-delivery experience and salaried at £77k–96k — this is plainly a senior, non-entry-level position with essential experience the candidate lacks. It is also outside all three interest zones and demands Lean/Agile/operational-excellence delivery expertise the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Business Architect
jobs.reason: The essential criteria demand established experience in business architecture, operating model design and transformation within complex organisations, plus a salary band and remit that signal a mid-level (non-entry) professional role the candidate does not have the post-graduation experience for. The topic (organisational design/operations) also sits outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Controller Transfer Pricing (m/f/d)
jobs.reason: This is a finance/controlling role requiring a background in accounting, controlling and cost structures, plus SAP and strong Excel — a skills profile the candidate (a policy/international-law researcher) does not have and which sits entirely outside their interest zones. It is nominally entry-level and does not require prior transfer-pricing experience, so it is not disqualified, but the paper fit and interest alignment are both very weak.

jobs.title: Senior Communications Officer
jobs.reason: The "Senior" title indicates a role beyond entry-level, requiring experience the candidate lacks. It is also a communications-specialist role, an area where the candidate has only limited dedicated experience, so it fails on both level and paper fit.

jobs.title: IT Service Desk Analyst
jobs.reason: Requires a minimum of five years of relevant experience plus specialised IT infrastructure skills (networking protocols, Azure, PowerShell, Office 365 administration) the candidate does not have, so it fails both the experience and technical essentials. Although Teneo is a target firm for geopolitical work, this is a technical IT support role entirely outside the candidate's profile and interests.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical data/AI engineering role whose essential requirements — strong Python for shipping testable production code, LLM orchestration, semantic layers, data pipelines and cloud tooling — are well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python. It sits on the wrong side of zone (c), and the software-engineering essentials constitute a hard skills disqualifier.

jobs.title: Fixed Income Data Product Owner
jobs.reason: This is a product-management role in fixed-income credit data requiring product-development experience, Agile methodology, Jira/Trello and SQL — a skills profile the candidate does not have and that sits outside their research/policy strengths. The 2+ years product-management experience is a soft obstacle rather than a strict disqualifier, but combined with the technical product-owner focus and financial-data subject far from the candidate's core interests, this is a poor fit.

jobs.title: Head of Division: Research Development (AC.06.3)
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD plus at least 5 years of post-PhD research experience and a senior "Head of Division" leadership role — multiple hard disqualifiers the candidate does not meet. It is also restricted to South African citizens/permanent residents and lies entirely outside the candidate's field (oral health sciences).

jobs.title: Designer
jobs.reason: This is a design role in a Brand & Comms department requiring graphic/visual design skills the candidate does not possess and has no background in. It falls outside all interest zones and is a clear skills mismatch for a research/policy-oriented profile.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Treasury Officer (4255)
jobs.reason: This is a finance / accounts-payable role requiring accounts-payable team experience, financial accounting and control skills, and systems like D365 and Concur — none of which the candidate's research profile provides, making paper fit very weak. Though hosted by a human-rights organisation, the function is pure back-office finance, well outside the candidate's research, policy and analysis strengths and interest zones.

jobs.title: Office and Finance Assistant (4256)
jobs.reason: Location is a hard filter (London only): this role is tied to Brussels with no London or remote-UK option. It also requires professional working knowledge of French or Dutch as an essential (candidate is only B1 French), and it is an administrative/finance-support role rather than research or policy work.

jobs.title: Associate Professor (LA.06.3)
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers: the role requires an already-completed PhD, enrolment as a practising Attorney of the High Court (a legal qualification the candidate lacks), and at least ten years' post-admission experience. It is also a senior professorial title far beyond entry level.

jobs.title: SCHOOL ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGER.4.05 (AD.08.4)
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — it is a "Manager" post explicitly requiring five to seven years of relevant experience plus financial management and staff supervision, none of which the candidate has. It is also outside all core interest zones, being an administrative finance role.

jobs.title: Diversity Equity and Inclusion Partner (7368)
jobs.reason: This is a senior DEI specialist role requiring proven experience delivering and embedding diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives in a complex organisation, plus facilitation and stakeholder-influencing experience the candidate does not have — the £61,500 salary confirms it is not entry-level. Although the candidate has some diversity-programme exposure at the Rectors' Conference, this is a dedicated DEI-professional post outside their core interest zones and beyond their experience level.

jobs.title: Interim (Senior) Strategy Manager
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — it is a Manager / Senior Manager role requiring established strategy experience via a top management consultancy or internal strategy function, plus coaching and leading others, which the candidate's student-assistant background does not meet. The social-impact innovation topic also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Health Data Innovation Lead – Challenge Works
jobs.reason: A "Lead" role at ~£66,800 requiring an experienced health-data specialist with deep technical expertise in biomedical datasets, data harmonisation and AI/computational research applications — well beyond entry-level and beyond the candidate's analysis-level skills. Health data innovation also sits outside the core interest zones, but the seniority and technical requirements are the hard disqualifiers.

jobs.title: Lecturer in the Global History of War and Conflict (Education)
jobs.reason: This is a Lecturer post that requires an established academic profile — module convening, dissertation supervision, a peer-reviewed publication record and effectively a completed PhD — none of which an MSc-in-progress candidate holds. Despite the perfect thematic fit with the candidate's war/conflict interests at KCL War Studies, the level and implicit doctorate requirement are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Head of Legal
jobs.reason: A "Head of" role is a senior leadership position, and a legal head almost certainly requires a legal qualification the candidate does not hold — two independent disqualifiers. The level and qualification are hard mismatches regardless of topical interest.

jobs.title: Board Members
jobs.reason: Board membership is a senior governance role requiring extensive experience and seniority the candidate does not have, and such positions are typically non-employment appointments rather than a genuine entry-level paid role. The level is a hard mismatch.
